mapper.insert: insert into bookings(id, user_id, flight_id, passenger_name, passenger_email, passenger_phone, seat_number, status, created_at, updated_at) values( #{booking.id}, #{booking.userId}, #{booking.flightId}, #{booking.passengerName}, #{booking.passengerEmail}, #{booking.passengerPhone}, #{booking.seatNumber}, #{booking.status}, #{booking.createdAt}, #{booking.updatedAt})
mapper.select: select count(*) from bookings where user_id = #{userId}
